name: Fixed Asset Detail
rows: First-year MACRS (20%) on $58,000 at 80% business use ($9,280), within the first-year limit of $9,760 ($12,200 x 80%); no special allowance elected. Basis per dealer invoice TM-88412 from Alder Point Truck Center, including utility body upfit and telematics; purchase approval per PO B1-2071. GPS unit 4471 active from release to service. Freight and upfit included in basis per the invoice schedule; no trade-in.

Qualified nonpersonal-use vehicle (permanent shelving, company livery, no personal miles); 100% special depreciation allowance on the full cost. Basis per invoice GV-33908 from Gulf Coast Van Works: chassis, permanent shelving package and livery; approval per PO B1-1984. No personal miles recorded for this unit. Sales tax on the chassis included in basis; livery billed separately on the same invoice.

Third-year limit row applied at 70% business use ($6,720); unrecovered basis $16,000 carried on the prior-year schedule. Basis per dealer invoice from Camellia Motors, May 2018; title held by the Controller's office. Limit row carried from the prior-year schedule. No 2025 additions or improvements; basis unchanged during the year.
Crew cab service truck - utility body

Section 179 election at full cost; carried in the general MACRS class as a service truck. Basis per dealer invoice TM-90221 from Alder Point Truck Center, including utility body; approval per PO B2-2417. Assigned to the HVAC service crew out of Branch 2. Trade-in allowance on the retired utility truck netted against the invoice price.

Section 179 election at full cost; carried in the general MACRS class as a service truck. Basis per dealer invoice TM-90354 from Alder Point Truck Center, including flatbed; approval per PO B2-2418. Assigned to the plumbing service crew out of Branch 2. Flatbed and rack installation billed on the dealer invoice and included in basis.

Section 179 of $20,200 claimed in 2023, limited by the first-year passenger automobile limit for the 2023 tax year; remaining basis on 5-year 200 DB MACRS, half-year convention. Basis per fleet invoice F-2023-114 from Gulf Coast Van Works. Prior-year depreciation per the 2024 schedule; remaining basis $51,600 carried into 2025. No 2025 additions or improvements; basis unchanged during the year.

Section 179 election on the December 2025 purchase invoice; qualified nonpersonal-use vehicle. Basis per dealer invoice GV-34127 from Gulf Coast Van Works; approval per PO B1-2233. Purchase invoice dated December 29, 2025. Sales tax and destination charge included in basis per the invoice.

100% special depreciation allowance on the December 2025 purchase invoice; qualified nonpersonal-use vehicle. Basis per dealer invoice GV-34128 from Gulf Coast Van Works; approval per PO B1-2234. Purchase invoice dated December 29, 2025. Sales tax and destination charge included in basis per the invoice.

First-year special depreciation allowance capped at the 2025 limit with special allowance ($20,200 x 85% = $17,170). Basis per dealer invoice HM-55701 from Camellia Motors; approval per PO B2-2301. Assigned to the project management group. Delivery fee and registration costs of the release included in basis.

Year 5 MACRS (5.76%) at 85% business use, within the later-years limit row for 2021 ($5,860 x 85%). Basis per dealer invoice TM-70119 including crane body installation; approval per PO B1-1509. Prior-year depreciation per the 2024 schedule. Crane body installation included in basis at acquisition; no later additions.

Year 4 deduction capped at the later-years limit row for 2022 ($6,460 x 90% = $5,814). Basis per dealer invoice HM-52088 from Camellia Motors; approval per PO B2-1774. Prior-year depreciation per the 2024 schedule. No 2025 additions or improvements; basis unchanged during the year.

Year 6 deduction capped at the later-years limit row for 2020 ($5,760 x 90% = $5,184). Basis per dealer invoice TM-66042 including plumbing rig outfitting; approval per PO B1-1302. Prior-year depreciation per the 2024 schedule. Rig outfitting included in basis at acquisition; no later additions.

Qualified nonpersonal-use vehicle; 5-year 200 DB MACRS, half-year convention, year 5 (5.76%). Basis per invoice GV-29004 from Gulf Coast Van Works: chassis, shelving and livery; approval per PO B1-1642. No personal miles recorded for this unit. Shelving and livery included in basis at acquisition; no later additions.
Branch 1 leasehold improvement - dispatch office build-out

Qualified improvement property, 15-year straight line, mid-month convention; full-year 2025 amount per the cost segregation invoice. Basis per contractor draw schedule CS-2024-07 from Dellinger Construction Group, plus architect fees; capitalized at occupancy per the lease. Prior-year depreciation per the 2024 schedule. Tenant improvement allowance netted against the cost per the lease side letter.
Shop equipment - diagnostic scanners and parts washers

100% special depreciation allowance; qualified property acquired after January 19, 2025, original use with the company. Basis per vendor invoices EW-88220 and EW-88221 from Eastwood Industrial Supply; approval per PO B1-2144. Placed in service at the Branch 1 shop. Installation and calibration included in basis per the vendor invoices.
Shop equipment - vehicle lifts and brake lathes

7-year 200 DB MACRS, half-year convention, year 3 (17.49%). Basis per vendor invoice EW-79104 from Eastwood Industrial Supply, including installation and anchoring; approval per PO B1-1422. Prior-year depreciation per the 2024 schedule. Anchoring and electrical work included in basis per the vendor invoice.

7-year 200 DB MACRS, half-year convention, year 2 (24.49%). Basis per vendor invoice PW-45519 from Pinnacle Warehouse Systems, including freight and installation; approval per PO B2-1590. Prior-year depreciation per the 2024 schedule. Freight and installation included in basis per the vendor invoice.

Section 179 election on a qualified real property improvement to the Branch 2 service building. Basis per contractor invoice DR-2025-02 from Dellinger Construction Group for the rooftop package units and controls; approval per PO B2-2541. Permitting and engineering fees included in basis per the contractor invoices.
Field equipment - welding rigs and compressors

Section 179 election at full cost; 7-year class machinery and equipment. Basis per vendor invoices WM-30117 and WM-30118 from Westmark Fabrication; approval per PO B1-2498. Field equipment pooled across both branches. Freight and field setup included in basis per the vendor invoices.

Section 179 election on energy property; the last 2025 election in the register's placed-in-service order. Basis per contractor invoice SR-2025-11 from Solaris Energy Installers, including racking and inverters; approval per PO B1-2602. Racking, inverters and monitoring included in basis per the contractor invoice.
Customer relationship intangible - Gulfport commercial acquisition

Section 197 intangible amortized over 180 months from July 2023; full-year 2025 amount. Basis per the asset purchase agreement dated June 30, 2023 for the Gulfport commercial services acquisition; allocation per the closing statement. Amortization begin month per the closing statement calendar.

Section 197 intangible amortized over 180 months from October 2024; full-year 2025 amount. Basis per the employment agreement dated September 24, 2024 with the former owner of the Gulfport book of business. Amortization begin month per the agreement's effective date.

Section 197 intangible amortized over 180 months from October 2025; three months of amortization in 2025. Basis per the trade name purchase agreement dated September 18, 2025; allocation per the closing statement. Amortization begin month per the closing statement calendar.
